install.summary: the knowledge base for a specific codebase — what it's made of and why
install.post_install:
software-development installed. Map your codebase first with the devwiki-map skill, or:
  python3 scripts/dev_tool.py new-component --name "<Name>" --kind service --path <src/dir>
Then use devwiki-feature / devwiki-change / devwiki-decision to record the work.
install.post_update:
software-development updated. Carry on with:
  python3 scripts/dev_tool.py status
Untouched _prompts/ were refreshed; any you tailored were preserved (see the prompts summary above).
